svg.text: Work RAM: floor plan, draft 5 (as the game has it, addressed)
top down, north up, as the game has it: the corridor comes in from the east. Each tower's address (row, column) at its foot: the debug text shows the one you stand on
slow DRAM: streets 200, jumps up to 225, climbs up to 100
fast: streets 200, jumps up to 225 (longer: to come)
BUILT in the game: columns 0-6, rows 0-11 (src/game/city.c). Dimmed: planned, not built
Orange: the watchdog drone as built, waiting at 3 floors down the street, scanning west (cyan)
As the game has it: walking out of the corridor (west), the rows south (Backup RAM) are on your left, the CD block on your right
drop: step off, up to 120 down
long drop: a stagger, calls the drone
vault ending in a long drop
guard page: too tall to stand on, a wall
sealed: higher than all round, out of reach
hub: a way out, and a lift up
data bus: the bridge between banks
open from the start: the first way out
CD block: the addresses read, a hidden way in
Backup RAM: a ghost save to draw the drone off its door
SCSP: a voice, to answer the hum
VDP1: a line drawn becomes a bridge
VDP2: a longer vault, over a freed block
Check: the shortest way to each
